notice: All values are refit as matches land and may change week to week. Sample sizes and fit quality are shown so the reader can judge each number.

ktpr_v2.name: KTPR v2
ktpr_v2.what: Per-match performance rating. How well you played in this match, independent of who won.
ktpr_v2.equation: z = Σ w_c · z_c over the components available for the match; each z_c is the player's per-match z-score on that component (mean 0, spread 1 across the players in the match). A missing component's weight is redistributed over the rest.

components.name: swing
components.what: attributed flag swing: the flag-control probability your kills and caps moved

components.name: kast_f
components.what: KAST-F: share of your lives with a kill, assist, survival or trade in a flag fight

display.what: 100 is the match average; 115 is one spread above it

mmr.name: MMR (OpenSkill)
mmr.what: Cross-match skill rating. How likely your side is to win, learned from results across the season. Carries an uncertainty that shrinks with matches played.
mmr.model: Plackett-Luce (openskill 6.2.0), two teams, each player's rating updated by the match result

initial.what: everyone starts here; sigma is the uncertainty

displayed.what: conservative is the value you are very likely at least as good as

prediction.n: the thinner side's mean matches played
prediction.what: a prediction between two barely-rated sides is pulled toward a coin flip; confidence is earned by evidence, not asserted by the model

performance_weighting.what: when on, a side's rating change is split by each player's KTPR contribution instead of evenly. Off until measured to predict better than even splits.

momentum.name: Momentum credit
momentum.what: Objective value traced back to the plays that enabled it. A 4k that leads to a cap and then a capout is paid part of that objective value, decaying with the lag.
mechanism: Every momentum event (multikill, cap, capout) is both a payout and a deposit for its team's ledger.
Payout: the event's value is split between the actor(s) and the team's outstanding deposits; the deposits' share at lag d is 1 − 1/lift(d).
Deposit: the event enters the ledger and forwards a fraction rho of anything it is later paid to the deposits that fed it — the secondary assist.
An enemy cap clears the ledger.
Kills earn nothing here; KTPR already counts them. This is objective lift only.
momentum.status: research — not yet a KTPR component

definitions.multikill: >= 3 kills by one player, each within 10s of the last
definitions.lift: P(objective within d s of a multikill) / the same team's own rate in that half
definitions.curve: lift(d) = 1 + A·exp(−lam·d); momentum share of an objective at lag d = 1 − 1/lift(d)
definitions.rho: fraction of a payout a deposit forwards to its own upstream deposits (secondary assist)
definitions.scoring: points = cap·caps + hold3·s + hold4·s + capout·capouts, per map, on demo-labelled halves
